content:
“All the hanker without the hunger!”

**Munchy Resistance** is an Endurance-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

It is exclusive to human players and cannot be equipped by ghoul players.

Chems restore hunger.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★★ | 2 | Chems restore twice as much hunger. | 00393F77 | 
| ★ | 1 | Chems restore hunger. | 00393F76 | 

- Before update 60, the perk had 2 ranks that reduced hunger generation by 50%/100%.

- Hydro Fix - similar perk for thirst
